attackers_goals: Perform lateral movement to new hosts to expand the foothold within a network.
description: A host that rarely initiates WMI to other remote hosts triggered a remote process execution by using WMI RPC.
investigative_actions: Investigate the processes being spawned on the host for malicious activities. Correlate the RPC call from the source host and understand which process or software initiated it.
name: Remote WMI process execution
